geometry_edits.rationale: Convert the incidental courtyard intent into an explicit access-aligned opening toward the verified site-access side so the ground edge reads as public threshold.
Make the opening wide enough to read as a usable entry/court rather than a decorative bite.
Deepen the threshold vertically so the void has sectional consequence and supports a clear ground response.
Keep the notch bounded so the dominant bent-bar mass remains intact while the public cut becomes legible.
Promote the access-aligned void to the root so the public threshold becomes the governing figure for the next iteration.

rationale: The candidate is a coherent early massing diagram with a single dominant bent-bar idea and acceptable multi-view consistency, but it reads as a compact, somewhat generic block with a clipped corner rather than a clearly neighborhood-oriented building. The parcel response is only partially legible: the mass sits within the boundary and has some orientation, but the dominant gesture does not strongly organize the parcel or create a convincing public figure. The most important program deficiency is the access edge: the verified frontage wants an active threshold or public court, yet the form appears comparatively sealed, with only a modest notch/void and no strong entry seam. The references consistently show that this program benefits from a clear courtyard, terrace, bridge, or active ground void rather than a simple carved chunk. Because the form does not yet deliver a convincing public threshold or robust void/public sequence, program_fit_hard_pass fails.

warnings: The mass is coherent across views but still reads as a generic bent extrusion rather than a clearly programmed neighborhood building.
Frontage response is weak relative to the verified access edge; the void is not yet public enough.
Sectional logic is underdeveloped for a mixed neighborhood program; the roof/mass top is more like a clipped cap than an inhabitable section.
Do not over-reward the non-rectangular footprint alone; the dominant gesture still needs clearer spatial consequence.
